description: t.w waits in its receiver's poll_closed (channel/oneshot.rs:1373). r.main is cancelled at 150 while t.d still sleeps (a script entry advances the clock without firing timers), so the sleep ends early and t.d's send finds its Cx cancelled: its reserve consumes the sender and closes the channel (:492-510), which wakes t.w's closed waiter; t.d observes ASX_E_CANCELLED.
